source.sqlReaderQuery:
WITH base_data
AS (
	SELECT t2.account_no
		,FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd_hhmmss') AS batch_id
		,t1.api_rk
		,t1.api_code
		,REPLACE(t1.api_url, '#ACCOUNT_NO', t2.account_no) AS api_url
		,t1.api_desc
		,t1.api_type
		,t1.api_prop
		,t1.api_override_applicable
		,t1.api_override_parameter_value
		,t1.last_run_successfully
		,t1.execution_seq_no
		,t1.valid_flag
		,t1.valid_from_date
		,t1.valid_to_date
		,t1.created_by
		,t1.created_on
		,t1.updated_by
		,t1.updated_on
		,t1.token
		,t1.dbase_name
		,CAST(t2.loan_rk AS VARCHAR(10)) + '_' + t2.account_no AS key_value
	FROM vw_api_master t1
	CROSS JOIN dim_loan t2
	WHERE t1.api_code = 'GET_LOAN_BY_AN'
		AND t2.valid_flag = 'Y'
	)
	,numbered_data
AS (
	SELECT *
		,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
			ORDER BY key_value ASC
			) AS RowNumber
		,-- Sequential numbering (no gaps)
		COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
	FROM base_data
	)
INSERT INTO LoanAdditionalInfoAPI (
	is_last_row
	,total_count
	,RowNumber
	,GroupNumber
	,account_no
	,api_rk
	,api_code
	,api_url
	,token
	,dbase_name
	,key_value
	)
SELECT CASE 
		WHEN RowNumber = total_count
			THEN '1'
		ELSE '0'
		END AS is_last_row
	,total_count
	,RowNumber
	,((RowNumber - 1) / 450) + 1 AS GroupNumber
	,account_no
	,api_rk
	,api_code
	,api_url
	,token
	,dbase_name
	,key_value
FROM numbered_data
ORDER BY RowNumber;

SELECT 1;
